steps.t: Apply the kill and scale rules every day

rules: Kill a creative after $20 spent with a click-through rate under 1%.
Kill a creative after $40 spent with no add-to-cart.
Scale a creative (+20% budget every 48h) while its CPA stays under $20 for 3 days running.
Kill the product if $300 is spent with no CPA under $35.
daily: amberhaven-daily runs at 8 AM while the Claude app is open. It only reads the store and reports orders, revenue, late shipments, stock problems and estimated profit, with a 7-day trend on Mondays.
